$comment: Packaged data: the chart palette as resolved sRGB hex, converted from the OKLCH design tokens it was drawn from — do not hand-edit single values. Hex, because the server-side chart renderer rasterises through resvg and cannot parse oklch(). To restyle charts, convert the whole palette from its token source and replace this file.
series_slots$comment: How wide the categorical palette IS, counted off the token tree rather than authored. Everything that needs the width reads this one key: adding a ninth `chart.N` token widens the artifact, and the consumers follow, instead of the artifact being quietly truncated to a literal written somewhere else. Contrast `validated_slots`, which is authored because it records where a MEASUREMENT stopped rather than a fact about the tree.
validated_slots$comment: Where validated separation ENDS, not where the palette does. Slots 1-4 pass the colourblind and contrast checks; 5-8 are a derived second tier that does not, and past 8 the renderers recycle from slot 1. None of those is a refusal to draw — the number of series is a property of the data. What makes the weaker tiers honest is that a direct label on every mark becomes mandatory at five series, one slot before this boundary.
